content.short: Pantera Capital is the United States' first institutional asset manager focused exclusively on blockchain technology.
content.description: Pantera Capital was launched in 2013 by former Tiger Management CFO Dan Morehead, when bitcoin traded around $65. It was the United States’ first cryptocurrency fund focused exclusively on blockchain technology and maintains multiple funds, including a venture capital fund and an early-stage token fund. Its notable venture bets include 1inch, Arbitrum, and Coinbase; early-stage token investments include 0x, Cosmos, Polkadot, PsyOptions, Filecoin, and Livepeer.
